observations.says: the passage door did not open from four until eight
Dunn was on the terrace from four until dusk, and the terrace door was shut the whole time
from dusk until eight Mr. Farrant was in the passage with Ellen
from dusk until the gong Philip was out of her sight
Mr. Farrant walked the terrace from five until dusk, past the terrace door
Philip sat with Ellen in the passage until dusk
after dusk Dunn was gone from the terrace
